How long does a garden room take to build?

Sam Fernleigh March 2, 2026

Most of our rooms take four weeks from the first dig to handing over the keys.

Week one: the base

We level the ground and lay a base of ground screws, so there is no concrete to cure.

Weeks two to four: frame, roof and finish

The frame goes up in two days. The rest of the time is insulation, glazing and the inside walls.
